quantity: posterior translation of the cage relative to the C4 endplate at the evaluation point (mm)

replicate.basis: pooled SD, 44 pairs in 36 degrees of freedom (replicate_agreement.json)

time_step.basis: p124, window_dt 0.001 vs production stepping, extension loading of cycles 1-2, RMS over the last degree before the intact ROM angle (every near-line verdict read-out is extension at the intact ROM), x 1.11 (Richardson q 10, order 1). Upper estimate: the differences alternate in sign (stick-slip texture), not smooth convergence

penalty.basis: p124, penalty x2 vs production, same angles, x 2 (penalty error ~ 1 / penalty). Upper estimate: the penalty arm has its own stepping, so its difference also carries the stick-slip texture

solver.basis: newton_confirm.json, full minus quasi-Newton at the evaluation point, 10 windows

static_vs_slow_dynamic.basis: NUM-08 (2026-11-21, p062, mu 0.35): extension at the intact ROM 0.4421 static vs 0.4426 slow dynamic; rectangular, half-width 0.0005

insertion_process.basis: NUM-15 (process G vs production, p062 / p094): extension at the intact ROM differs <= 0.001 mm; rectangular, half-width 0.001. Flexion differs 0.02-0.05 mm (usage limit R13); no near-line read-out is a flexion read-out

excluded.anchor_drift: NUM-13 (2026-11-18): hold-phase trend <= 0.0022 mm and production vs half step <= 0.0008 mm; the residual is part of the measured time-step term
excluded.increments_density_20261105: DECISIONS 2026-11-05 18:08: p062 extension at the intact ROM 0.446-0.566 mm across increment counts / density under the FEBio friction law that resets the stick point every increment (physio_fric3). Superseded by the stick-memory law of every current window (PI 2026-11-09 decision 2, NUM-13 pass 2026-11-18); what is left of the effect is the time-step term above
excluded.mesh: not measured for this read-out; the guard band room left is reported as mesh_allowance
excluded.model_form: outside the numerical budget: friction coefficient, material law, boundary conditions, validation accuracy, and the uncertainty of the 0.5 mm limit itself (FDA 2023 names them next to calculation verification)

guard_band.note: w = distance from the PI pass line 0.45 to the PI nominal limit 0.5 mm (PI 2026-11-03 04:30, grey zone PI 2026-11-10); guarded acceptance needs w >= U

references: FDA, Assessing the Credibility of Computational Modeling and Simulation in Medical Device Submissions, final guidance, Nov 2023 (section on post-study adequacy: proximity of predictions to decision or safety thresholds, with uncertainty)
ASME V&V 40-2018, Assessing Credibility of Computational Modeling through Verification and Validation: Application to Medical Devices
JCGM 100:2008 (GUM), Evaluation of measurement data - Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
ISO 5725-6:1994 (confirmed 2022), Accuracy (trueness and precision) of measurement methods and results - Part 6: Use in practice of accuracy values (repeatability limit r = 2.8 s_r)
JCGM 106:2012, Evaluation of measurement data - The role of measurement uncertainty in conformity assessment; ILAC-G8:09/2019, Guidelines on Decision Rules and Statements of Conformity
Richardson extrapolation for spatial / temporal convergence (Roache 1998, as summarised by the NASA NPARC Alliance CFD V&V tutorial, https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/wind/valid/tutorial/spatconv.html)
